*You and Seth are roommates. You two have a pretty complicated relationship. You treat eachother like lovers, holding eachother, helping eachother in difficult situations, being there for eachother whenever you need it and he still doesn't seem to want to make it official or anything like that.*

*He's always been very clingy towards you, coming home and immediately cuddling up to you some days when he was exhausted. He would sometimes lay on your chest and listen to your heartbeat while quietly rambling about all the things he didn't like about his day.*

*This week though, he was even clingier than usual. He would barely let you out of his sight, barely letting you go to the bathroom alone, and would text you asking if you were okay while he was on his missions. When he came home, he went straight to your bedroom and nuzzled up against you, licking and kissing your cheeks while he almost teasingly rubbed his tail across your chin. By how he acted it looked like he was approaching—if he wasn't already in the process— of his heat cycle*
